traceability.notes: All acceptance criteria for 024.0-DEV-IGNORE-INLINE-CODE-REFS are concretely met: - Backtick-wrapped @story/@req/@supports are removed before annotation detection with a centralized, length-preserving filter in normalizeCommentLine. - Common documentation patterns (e.g., "`@story` + `@req`", "using `@supports`...") no longer surface as annotations, while real annotations outside backticks are still detected. - Unit tests explicitly tied to this story cover core behavior, mixed real + inline-code scenarios, multiple backtick spans, and unchanged behavior for non-backtick lines. - The full Jest suite passes, demonstrating no regressions. - The normalization JSDoc and inline comments clearly document the inline-code filtering behavior. Therefore, the story is fully implemented and verified.
